import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import controller, planlib, probability
case = {"model":"cnn","class_values":[5,4,3,2,1,1,1],"stats":[7,9,11],
 "bucket":[3,1],
 "slots":[[0,2,0],[5,1,2],[9,2,1]],
 "flows":[[2,3,0,1],[1,2,-1,3]],
 "groups":[[-1,4]],
 "windows":[[0,0,9,10,3,0,2,[[1,1]]*9],
            [1,1,5,20,1,0,7,[[2,2]]*9],
            [0,5,9,300,301,0,1,[[3,3]]*9]]}
req={'version':3,'cases':[case]}
resp = controller.run(json.dumps(req).encode())
r=resp['results'][0]
preds=r['predictions']; thr=r['thresholds']
ep,ratio,cut,ok = None,None,None,None
# rebuild plan objects for display
import planlib
thr = probability.window_thresholds(case['stats'], case['windows'])
W = 1+3*case['slots'][-1][0]
value=[case['windows'][j][6]*case['class_values'][preds[j]] for j in range(3)]
ep = planlib.Plan(case['bucket'],case['slots'],case['flows'],case['groups'],case['windows'],preds,thr,value,W)
ep.build_arcs(); ep.build_aux()
idx=ep.ratio_search(); ratio=ep.rset[idx]; low=ep.lowers(ratio); ep.set_lowers(low)
ep.optimise(low); ep.potentials(low); cut = ep.cut_for(idx) if ratio<1 else None
S,J,F,G = ep.S,ep.J,ep.F,ep.G
def nm(v):
    if v==0: return 'R'
    if v==1: return 'Z'
    if 2<=v<2+3*S:
        k=v-2; return ['a','b','e'][k%3]+str(k//3)
    if v<ep.zbase: return 'w%d'%(v-ep.wbase)
    if v<ep.hbase: return 'z%d'%(v-ep.zbase)
    return 'h%d'%(v-ep.hbase)
print('ratio',ratio,'low',low,'ok',ok,'value',value,'W',W,'thr',thr,'preds',preds)
print('assignment',ep.assignment,'U',ep.utility,'A',ep.age)
print('%-4s %-5s %-5s %-5s %-5s %-12s %s'%('#','tail','head','low','cap','cost','flow'))
for i in range(ep.narcs):
    print('%-4d %-5s %-5s %-5d %-5d %-12s %d'%(i,nm(ep.tail[i]),nm(ep.head[i]),ep.lowarr_for(low)[i],ep.capa[i],ep.cost[i],ep.arcflow[i]))
print('cut',cut, [nm(v) for v in (cut or [])])
print('pot', ep.pot)
EOF
